scope.description: CAF Defence Industrial Strategy refresh across official policy, Defence Investment Agency, government procurement and funding programs, NRC innovation sources, departmental plans and live demand matching; qualified leads continue automatically into review candidates.

source.title: Canada's Defence Industrial Strategy
